arguments.description: Check coord state and queue tail
arguments.command:
Write-Output '--- coord/STATE.md tail'
Get-Content coord/STATE.md -Tail 40 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- coord/queue.md tail'
Get-Content coord/queue.md -Tail 30 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- AUDIT_LEDGER tail'
Get-Content AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 20 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
